create.name: Dakota Earth Cloud Walker
create.bio:
Dakota Earth Cloud Walker is a Celtic shamanic teacher and sound artist who lives on a homestead in Maine, where she records her guided journeys in a small backyard studio she calls the Bone Hut. She left organised religion at nineteen and has followed a druidic and shamanic path since 1992. She studied shamanic breathwork under Linda Star Wolf and trance dance under Ernesto Ortiz, took Jungian studies, and trained with the Order of Bards, Ovates and Druids, through which she also works as a celebrant. She is an ordained minister of shamanic spirituality and once wrote the professional development curriculum for a large massage therapy school.

At the centre of her teaching is the Living Wheel, a medicine wheel framework that links the four directions, the seasons and Celtic cosmology to daily life and to soul archetypes. She teaches it through long cinematic sound journeys, ritual writing, live circles on Zoom and a year-long programme of nine-week arcs done outdoors. Her site holds a library of more than two hundred journeys, workbooks and music, alongside the Soul Fire Collective membership, and she offers private sessions that mix oracle work, coaching through the wheel and guided journeying.

courses.title: Private Soul Sessions
courses.description: One-to-one sessions that run from a short live oracle reading to coaching through the medicine wheel and a two-hour guided journey. She shapes each session around the person and the direction of the wheel they are working in.
courses.price: From $55 USD (30 minutes) to $200 USD (120 minutes)

courses.title: Soul Fire Collective
courses.description: Her membership community, with an archive of retired journeys, online oracle decks and writing prompts, a monthly live journey and themed circles. A higher tier adds her live online events.

courses.title: The Wheel of Your Wild Becoming: Instinct Arc
courses.description: The second nine-week arc of her year-long programme, moving from North to East on the medicine wheel, with outdoor practices, recorded journeys and live calls. Each arc can be taken on its own.

courses.title: Soul Alchemy Integration Sessions
courses.description: A two-hour live gathering on Zoom at each full moon, combining ritual, guided journeying, drumming, chanting and breath, with prompts to take home afterwards. Each month follows the moon and a Celtic Ogham tree.

courses.title: Medicine Circle – Soul Archetypes & the Wheel
courses.description: A live Zoom circle on the four archetypes held in the medicine wheel, East to North, and on recognising the direction you lean on most. Limited to twenty places, with a replay.

courses.title: Medicine Circle – Walking the Wheel
courses.description: The follow-on Zoom circle, using all four directions together as a practical way to think through decisions, projects and relationships. A replay is included.

courses.title: Tools For Your Shamanic Journey
courses.description: A ten-day Insight Timer course that walks beginners through preparing for and taking a shamanic journey, one short lesson at a time.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Dream Alchemy – Soul Flight of the Shaman
courses.description: A downloadable workbook on conscious dreaming, dream recall and shamanic journeying to the lower, middle and upper worlds, with exercises and rituals. It comes in a short and a full edition.

free_resources.title: Dakota Earth Cloud Walker on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Free shamanic journeys, medicine wheel meditations and soundscapes recorded in her Maine studio, to hear in the app or on the web.

free_resources.title: Bone Hut Oracle free draws
free_resources.description: Her own writing oracles can be tried on her site without signing up. Each draw gives a prompt and a few ways into it for journaling or reflection.
